_kopf.text: The Alias Workbench has no running process — everything happens in the Admin tab. These settings control how it writes.

_ikonText.text: Admin ships 62 function and 58 room templates, each with an icon. When the workbench creates an enumeration, it takes the icon from there. Existing enumerations keep whatever they have — unless you allow it to fill in what is missing. Nothing is ever written without the dry run showing it first.

ikonRaeume.label: Add missing icons to rooms
ikonRaeume.help: Applies when a room has no icon at all and a template of the same name or ID exists.

ikonFunktionen.label: Add missing icons to functions
ikonFunktionen.help: Same for functions. Enumerations mirrored from a HomeMatic CCU never carry an icon.

ikonErsetzen.label: Also replace unusable icon entries
ikonErsetzen.help: The Admin setup wizard leaves a bare name such as "Playroom" in the icon field, which no longer resolves to a picture and shows as a broken box. With this on, the workbench replaces it. It overwrites a field that is not empty — the dry run names it explicitly.

vorlagenVomAdmin.label: Offer the Admin's room and function templates
vorlagenVomAdmin.help: The workbench reads them at runtime from the Admin's own bundle instead of keeping a copy that would age with every update. If that fails, the selection lists simply show what already exists — no error, just fewer entries.
